newsitem.title: USA: Culbro interest in Eli Witt not significant.
newsitem.headline: Culbro interest in Eli Witt not significant.

text.p: Culbro Corp said on Tuesday that its interest in Eli Witt Co, which it said filed for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code in order to sell its operating assets, was not significant.
The cigar company said it had a partial interest in Eli Witt, but that its remaining financial investment in the wholesale distribution business was not significant.
Eli Witt entered into a contract to sell all of its operating assets to H.T. Hackney Co of Knoxville, Tenn., another wholesale distributor, Culbro said.
Eli Witt filed for reorganization in order to effect the sale, which would be subject to court approval, Culbro said.
The distributor had also agreed debtor-in-possession financing through a syndicate of banks, which would allow its operations to continue, Culbro said.
